blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (`rename_all = "camelCase"` silently renames every existing field of the public order JSON) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (New required `default_currency` key makes existing `config.toml` files fail to load) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub order_id: i64,
    pub customer_id: i64,
    pub total_cents: i64,
findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so that `GET /orders/{id}` keeps emitting `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents`, and only adds `currency` (single-word, unaffected). Today a partner integration that reads `order["order_id"]` gets nothing after the release: the response now carries `orderId`, `customerId` and `totalCents`, with no **BREAKING** item in the proposal's release note and against docs/api.md, which still lists the snake_case names and promises "a field is never renamed or removed without two releases of deprecation". If camelCase is wanted, it is a separate change that emits both names for two releases, is marked BREAKING and announced. Add a test that serializes an `OrderResponse` and asserts the documented field names.
findings.title: `rename_all = "camelCase"` silently renames every existing field of the public order JSON

findings.recommendation: Give the field a default (`#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning `"EUR"`, the currency every existing order was in) so that a deployed `config.toml` holding only `database_url` and `listen` keeps loading. As it stands, `toml::from_str` fails with "missing field `default_currency`" and the service refuses to start after the upgrade; only config.example.toml was updated, and the release note does not tell operators to add the key. If a required key is intended, mark it **BREAKING** in the release note with the line to add. Add a test that loads the pre-change configuration.
findings.title: New required `default_currency` key makes existing `config.toml` files fail to load
